blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Jedric Daa had the tall task of defending La Salle’s guards in Far Eastern University’s 90-78 win in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Wednesday at Mall of Asia Arena. But when Daa was credited for the struggles of the Green Archers’ backcourt threats, he quickly deflected the praise to FEU’s big men. “That wasn’t just because of me,” he said, candidly, in Filipino. “The bigs also did their parts on why that happened.” “When I get beat, they pick up on defense.
